# OS One Universe — Project Plan (v2025.09.23)

## Phase 1: UI/UX Launch

- Goal: Deliver a stable first-user experience where Assistants mediate user ↔ Agent communication.
- Deliverable: User can chat with one external LLM (OpenAI Responses) and one local LLM (Ollama/Open-WebUI) via the OS One UI.
- Guardrails: Redaction ON by default, Direct Agent mode OFF by default.

## Active Focus

- Finalize **Agent Toolbar** with QuickSwitch, Direct Agent toggle, and AgentStatus chip.
- Ensure **handover workflow** is documented and consistent.

## Next Tasks (Runway)

T1. **Finalize First Chat Readiness**: confirm AgentStatus chip + Quick Test across external (OpenAI) and local (Ollama).  
T2. **Audit Direct-Agent Mode**: add mini audit sink and visible footer label “Mediated / Direct”.  
T3. **Expose Context Visibility**: add “Context” pill with read-only injected context view.  
T4. **Onboarding Overlay**: build 3-slide overlay (Quick Switch, Direct toggle, Quick Test).  
T5. **SEC-COMMS Placeholder**: mount non-functional SEC-COMMS pill with tooltip, policy reminder.
